title: Leo XIV, Trying to Be Everyone’s Pope, Tours Secular France
summary_full: After visiting Africa, Pope Leo’s four-day trip to France shows how he is seeking to appeal to Roman Catholicism’s original heartlands as well as to the church’s newest strongholds.
